config.label: Atlassian site cloud id (a UUID)
config.description: Atlassian site cloud id (a UUID). Find it at https://<your-site>.atlassian.net/_edge/tenant_info

config.label: Atlassian account email, for API token auth
config.description: Atlassian account email, for API token auth. Required unless JSM_OAUTH_TOKEN is set.

config.label: Atlassian account API token, paired with JSM_EMAIL
config.description: Atlassian account API token, paired with JSM_EMAIL. Required unless JSM_OAUTH_TOKEN is set.

config.label: OAuth 3LO or Forge bearer token
config.description: OAuth 3LO or Forge bearer token. Takes precedence over JSM_EMAIL and JSM_API_TOKEN.
